question: Should `@openclaw/retry` and the retry runtime barrel become supported plugin-facing APIs, or should this consolidation remain an internal package used only by repository-owned code?
rationale: The generated Plugin SDK baseline and extension boundary changes may create a lasting external compatibility contract; repository policy requires explicit maintainer intent for that surface.

options.title: Keep It Internal
options.body: Retain the shared package for repository-owned callers but remove plugin-facing exports and generated public API exposure.

options.title: Approve Plugin API
options.body: Keep the plugin-facing surface and document its compatibility expectations with focused API and upgrade coverage.

options.title: Narrow The Repair
options.body: Fix the memory-host drift without migrating all retry loops if maintainers do not want to own the broader shared boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep It Internal
recommendation.body: Retain the shared package for repository-owned callers but remove plugin-facing exports and generated public API exposure.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current consolidation and linked issue and are the strongest available owner for the proposed package boundary.
